 This Criminal Petition Is Filed U/Sec. 482 Of Cr.P.C.
 Seeking To Quash The Complaint And Fir Against The
 Petitioners No.1 And 2/Accused No.1 And 2 In Raibag P.S.
 Crime No. 172/2023 For The Offences U/Sec. 498A, 324, 342,
 307, 504, 506, 109 R/W Sec. 34 Of Ipc, Pending On The File Of
 Principal Civil Judge And Jmfc Raibag Vide Annexure -A And
 B Respectively.
 -2-
 Nc: 2023:Khc-D:7527
 Crl.P No. 101429 of 2023
 This Petition, Coming On For Orders, This Day, The
Court Made The Following:
 Order
Parties present with their respective counsel.
2. Contents of the joint memo read over to the parties in the Kannada language.

Parties agree that the terms of the joint memo depict the true terms of settlement and parties have retraced their differences and the second respondent is now living with the petitioners along with her children.
3. Taking note of the fact that the offences alleged against the petitioners are non-bailable in nature and in terms of the true settlement and also the dispute was privy to the parties not having any serious social impact, following the dictum of the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Ramgopal and another Vs. State of Madhya Pradesh reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 834, pending proceedings against the petitioners needs to be quashed.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:7527 4.
